# package otfp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp"
```

Package otfp fingerprints operational-technology (OT) protocols on a network endpoint with safe, connection-level probes.

The library detects which industrial protocol an endpoint speaks — Modbus TCP, SunSpec, IEC 61850 MMS, Siemens S7comm, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, PROFINET, DNP3, IEC 60870-5-104, EtherNet/IP, OCPP, IEEE 2030.5, OpenADR, KNXnet/IP, MQTT, Sparkplug B, CAN (SLCAN gateways) and CANopen (CiA 309-3 gateways) — by exchanging each protocol's standard handshake or a single harmless request, never by writing, controlling or changing a device's configuration. In identify mode it additionally issues each protocol's read-only identity request (Read Device Identification, the CIP Identity object, SZL, MMS Identify, the BACnet Device object, OPC UA GetEndpoints, PROFINET I&M0, and the like) and reports vendor, model, version and serial where the device provides them.

The engine ([core.Engine](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/core#Engine)) runs the registered fingerprinters against a [core.Target](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/core#Target), trying those of the target's well-known port first, stopping early on a confident match, and returning a [core.Report](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/core#Report). The command otprobe (./cmd/otprobe) wraps the library for the shell.

This module has no dependencies outside the Go standard library and the CLI's cobra. The sibling go-\<protocol> libraries and the -interop container suites are used to validate the fingerprinters, not at runtime.

## Functions

### func DefaultEngine

```go
func DefaultEngine() *core.Engine
```

DefaultEngine returns an engine over DefaultRegistry with [core.DefaultEngineConfig](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/core#DefaultEngineConfig).

### func DefaultRegistry

```go
func DefaultRegistry() *core.Registry
```

DefaultRegistry returns a registry pre-loaded with every built-in fingerprinter.

### func Fingerprinters

```go
func Fingerprinters() []core.Fingerprinter
```

Fingerprinters returns a fresh instance of every built-in fingerprinter, over both TCP and UDP. EtherNet/IP and KNXnet/IP appear twice, once per transport.

### func NewEngine

```go
func NewEngine(config core.EngineConfig) *core.Engine
```

NewEngine returns an engine over DefaultRegistry with the given configuration.
